description: This file contains unit tests for the 'Trace' class, including tests for trace entry retrieval, frame mapping, slicing by entries, time, and frames, as well as handling of unavailable or empty frame info.

methods.name: getEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a trace entry by index, supports negative indexing, throws if index is out of bounds.

methods.name: getFrame
methods.description: Retrieves frame information for a given frame index, throws if frame info is unavailable.

methods.name: findClosestEntry
methods.description: Finds the closest trace entry to a given timestamp.

methods.name: findFirstGreaterOrEqualEntry
methods.description: Finds the first trace entry with timestamp greater than or equal to the given time.

methods.name: findFirstGreaterEntry
methods.description: Finds the first trace entry with timestamp strictly greater than the given time.

methods.name: findLastLowerOrEqualEntry
methods.description: Finds the last trace entry with timestamp less than or equal to the given time.

methods.name: findLastLowerEntry
methods.description: Finds the last trace entry with timestamp less than the given time.

methods.name: sliceEntries
methods.description: Returns a sliced subset of trace entries based on start and end indices.

methods.name: sliceTime
methods.description: Returns a subset of trace entries within a specified time range.

methods.name: sliceFrames
methods.description: Returns a subset of frame information within specified frame index range.

methods.name: getFramesRange
methods.description: Returns the range of frame indices covered by the trace.
